task_text: Add a static route entry under l3leaf.defaults.static_routes with destination_address_prefix '192.168.0.0/24' and gateway '192.168.10.1', so that it applies to all leaf nodes by default. The entry should follow AVD eos_designs format: - destination_address_prefix: '192.168.0.0/24'  gateway: '192.168.10.1'
reasoning: Static routes for leaf nodes in AVD eos_designs are defined under l3leaf.defaults.static_routes in the L3 leaves group_vars file, which applies the route to all leaf nodes.
